Labeled sibling case-0008 ("pre-approved under the team event budget" → approved) confirms the note-phrasing convention. Fits the "valid" target: plausible-looking odd purchase whose unusualness turns out to be allowed, with a mild distractor (the "equipment"-categorized pump).
